lines.text: A neural network is a team of tiny decision helpers.
lines.caption: A neural network is a team of tiny decision helpers.

lines.text: Each helper receives simple clues, like edges, curves, or bright spots.
lines.caption: Each helper receives simple clues: edges, curves, or bright spots.

lines.text: The next layer combines those clues through weighted connections.
lines.caption: The next layer combines clues through weighted connections.

lines.text: A node adds its bias, sums the signals, then applies an activation.
lines.caption: A node adds bias, sums the signals, then applies an activation.

lines.text: Training tunes those weights until the layers learn which clues matter.
lines.caption: Training tunes the weights until the layers learn which clues matter.

lines.text: Those learned patterns become the network's answer.
lines.caption: Those learned patterns become the network's answer.
